Mobile Suit Gundam: The 500 pound gorilla of mecha anime. Gundam is a huge, sprawling franchise. The original series has some elements of shows that were clearly made for kids, but is well known for its very serious anti-war themes and meticulous hard sci-fi worldbuilding.

Here are my two recommendations. The Fable. Fable, an assassin who works in organized crime, has been raised to legendary status as a ruthless killer capable of murdering any man within six seconds. Six years after his debut, his boss fears that Fable has attracted too much attention from legal authorities, and he orders him to hide in Osaka for a year. Accompanied by his driver, who assumes the identity of his sister, Fable must act as a civilian and not murder anyone lest he and his partner lose their lives. Parasyte: The Maxim. All of a sudden, parasitic aliens descended upon Earth and quickly infiltrated humanity by burrowing into the brains of vulnerable targets. These beings acquire full control of their hosts and can morph into forms to feed on unsuspecting prey.

As an important heads up, if you are interested in watching Higurashi When They Cry, make sure to start with either the 2006 anime and its second half Kai, the original visual novel, or the manga adaptation. The 2020 anime Higurashi When They Cry: Gou is an anime-original sequel, not a remake. Don't accidentally start with Gou because it contains spoilers.

I recommend the work of Masaaki Yuasa, particularly Tatami Galaxy and Ping Pong if you're looking for a series, or Lu Over the Wall if you want to check out his vibe with a movie first. The man has a talant with stories that tap into both the difficulties and the beauties of life.

Ranma 1/2 (Mappa Remake). This one might be a longshot since it focuses on high school kids, although the school setting is rarely used. It is a readaptation of the manga by Rumiko Takahashi, who is to romantic-comedy manga what Akira Toriyama is to battle shonen. Still set in 90's, barely past Showa-era Tokyo, it is first and foremost a comedy, but it draws in drama, action, and romance into a very unique mix. Season 3 is currently airing on Netflix. Mostly here because it is high quality and the 90's nostalgia might be appealing.
